items.html: Afterward comes the Vav of the inclusive SAG, which is VAK — namely, its ZA of Tevuna. Then the two lower points of the Yod that is in the Yod of the filling of the Hey of Bina, as above, in the aspect of internality together with their externality as well, descend to become the aspect of Mochin for these VAK, which are the Vav of the inclusive SAG — just as Tevuna clothes in the secret of Mochin for ZA.
